messages:
remy: FYI onboarding llama5p via gemma-bridge into int4. Quick summarization regressions on news-sum and conv QA. Repro below.

remy: Repro:
```
python convert.py --src=llama5p --target=gemma-bridge --quant=int4 --group=128 --out=./llama5p-gb
./eval/harness --model ./llama5p-gb --task news-sum --seed 5
```

jia: Numbers?

remy: Rouge-L -4.9, hallucination ~9% (was ~2%), ppl +0.6. Quick tokenmap parity showed EOS and tail ids shifted by +1 for ids > 50240. Also per-head rotary inv_freq shows tiny deltas (~1.0005) on heads 1 and 8.

sam: Run a logits ddiff float vs quant (first 128 tokens) and emit per-step top-5 mismatch + head L2. Also try ablations: group=64 and per-tensor quant.

ci-bot: Job queued: 1699999999-ci-llama5p-audit.

ci-bot: Job finished: divergence starts ~token 14; top-5 mismatch rises 3%->16% by token 40. Head L2 highest on heads 1 and 8. Tokenmap diff confirms trailing ids off by +1.

natalie: Tiny rotary scale deltas can amplify autoregressively. Quick experiments: 1) apply tokenmap correction (+1) for trailing ids, 2) apply inv_freq *= 0.9995 on the affected heads, 3) re-run a 10-sample news-sum smoke.

remy: Hotpatch applied (tokenmap fix + rotary shim). Smoke results: Rouge-L gap down to ~0.9, hallucinations ~3.2%. Group-size 64 gave minor improvement but not as large as the rotary shim.

oliver: Action items: add tokenmap parity check in converter that fails on trailing-region aliasing; add per-head rotary sanity check (warn if ratio deviates >5e-4) and an optional --auto-fix-rotary flag. Consider storing per-model rotary metadata in the catalog to avoid heuristics.

sam: I'll open a PR to add the checks and wire a 10-sample smoke eval into CI. ETA EOD tomorrow.

remy: Filed MLD-6001: "llama5p->gemma-bridge int4: trailing tokenmap aliasing + per-head rotary scale causing summary regressions" and attached ddiff + artifacts.

ci-bot: Closing job 1699999999-ci-llama5p-audit (artifacts: /ci/artifacts/1699999999/).
